title: Corporate Legal Associate
summary: A corporate legal associate drafts and reviews commercial contracts, researches legal questions and supports company law compliance for a business or a law firm's clients. In-house, they sit in a small legal team that advises sales, procurement and finance; in a law firm, they work under partners on corporate and commercial matters.
dailyDuties: Draft and review vendor, customer, service and partnership agreements
Negotiate commercial and legal terms with counterparties
Research statutes and case law and write short legal notes
Support board meetings, resolutions and Companies Act compliance
Coordinate legal notices and disputes with external counsel
Help prepare regulatory filings and due diligence reports
Answer legal questions from business teams

skills.expectation: Draft commercial agreements such as NDAs, service, vendor and distribution contracts
Review and mark up counterparty contracts against the company's positions
Negotiate key commercial and legal terms with counterparties
Research statutes and case law and write short legal notes for the business
Apply the Indian Contract Act and related laws to indemnity, liability and termination clauses
Support corporate governance and Companies Act 2013 compliance
Coordinate disputes and notices with external counsel and keep a litigation tracker
Advise sales, procurement and finance teams and work to business timelines
Explain legal risk in plain written and spoken English
Assist on legal due diligence for investments or acquisitions
Help prepare board resolutions, notices and minutes
Support regulatory filings on the MCA portal
Support FEMA filings for foreign investment
Review data protection clauses under the DPDP Act
Route, approve and store contracts in a contract management tool such as Icertis, Ironclad or DocuSign CLM
